splitting the dataset into x_train,...y_test
```{r}

student_number <- 4402375 
seed<-student_number %% 100
set.seed(seed)


train_indices <- sample(1:nrow(MH_data),size=1000)
train_data <- MH_data[train_indices, ]
test_data <- MH_data[-train_indices, ]
target_column <- which(names(MH_data) == "dep_sev_fu")
x_train <- train_data[,-target_column]
y_train <- train_data[[target_column]]
x_test <- test_data[,-target_column]
y_test<- test_data[[target_column]]

```

checking class distribution

```{r}
y <- MH_data[[target_column]]
class_distribution <- table(y)
print("Class Distribution for y:")
print(class_distribution)
```

Using random forest with a specific ntree=500, mtry=3. 
```{r}
randomforest_model <- randomForest(dep_sev_fu ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, mtry = 3, importance = TRUE)

randomforest_preds <- predict(randomforest_model, newdata = x_test)
rf_rootmeanse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$dep_sev_fu - randomforest_preds)^2))
print(paste("The Random Forest RMSE is:", rf_rootmeanse))

accuracy <- sum(randomforest_preds == y_test) / length(y_test)

print("Random forest accuracy is given below")
print(paste("Random Forest Accuracy:", accuracy))

varImpPlot(randomforest_model)
```
```{r}
influence_levels <- randomforest_model$importance
print(influence_levels)
```


Using cross fold validation for different mtry

```{r}
crossval <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

randomforest_model_crossval <- train(dep_sev_fu ~ ., 
                     data = train_data, 
                     method = "rf", 
                     trControl = crossval,
                     tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)),
                     ntree = 500)

print("Best model summary is")
print(randomforest_model_crossval$bestTune)

cv_rmse_error_10 <- mean(rf_model_cv$resample$RMSE)
print(paste("Cross-validated RMSE over 10 folds:", cv_rmse_error_10 ))

cv_accuracy_10 <- mean(randomforest_model_crossval$resample$Accuracy)
print(paste("Cross-validated Accuracy over 10 folds:", cv_accuracy_10))

randomforest_predictions <- predict(rf_model_cv, newdata = test_data)

rf_rmse_test <- sqrt(mean((test_data$dep_sev_fu - randomforest_predictions)^2))
print(paste("Random Forest RMSE on test:", rf_rmse_test))

accuracy <- sum(round(rf_preds) == test_data$dep_sev_fu) / length(test_data$dep_sev_fu)
print(paste("Random Forest Accuracy on test:", accuracy))

```


Running with different number of runs

```{r}
rmse_values <- c()
num_runs <- 5
accuracies <- numeric(0)
cv_rmse_values <- c()
cv_accuracy_values <- numeric(0)

for (i in 1:num_runs) {
  set.seed(4402375 + i) 
  
  randforest_preds <- predict(randomforest_model_crossval, newdata = test_data)
  rmse_values <- c(rmse_values, sqrt(mean((test_data$dep_sev_fu - randforest_preds)^2)))
  accuracies[i] <- sum(round(randforest_preds) == test_data$dep_sev_fu) / length(test_data$dep_sev_fu)

}

print(paste("Average RMSE over", num_runs, "runs:", mean(rmse_values)))
print(paste("Average Accuracy over", num_runs, "runs:", mean(accuracies)))
```


```{r}
library(glmnet)


x_train <- as.matrix(train_data[, -1])
x_test <- as.matrix(test_data[, -1])

lasso_model_l1 <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train_data[, -1]), train_data$dep_sev_fu, 
                         alpha = 1, family = "gaussian", 
                         type.measure = "mse", nfolds = 10)

lasso_predictions <- predict(lasso_model_l1, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min")

lasso_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$dep_sev_fu - lasso_predictions)^2))
lasso_accuracy <- sum(round(lasso_predictions) == test_data$dep_sev_fu) / length(test_data$dep_sev_fu)

print(paste("Lasso RMSE:", lasso_rmse))
print(paste("Lasso Accuracy:", lasso_accuracy))

best_lambda <- lasso_model_l1$lambda.min
print(best_lambda)

```

```{r}
print(lasso_model_l1$glmnet.fit$beta[, which.min(lasso_model_l1$cvm)])
```
